shelters.name: Humane Society of South Mississippi
shelters.description: Incorporated 1952, only open admissions shelter in South Mississippi. Cared for 5,000+ homeless pets in 2024, touches 16,000 animals in community. Countdown to Zero initiative.

shelters.name: Southern Pines Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Open admission, no-kill shelter providing humane shelter, affordable spay/neuter, healthy pet services, and community education.

shelters.name: Hub City Humane Society
shelters.description: No-kill shelter with 90% adoption/placement rate. Specializes in adoptions and caring for mistreated pets with transport services across state lines.

shelters.name: Tupelo-Lee Humane Society
shelters.description: Founded December 1979, 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Contracts with City of Tupelo and Lee County. Houses 6,000 animals per year.

shelters.name: Pearl River County SPCA
shelters.description: Provides shelter, medical treatment, and adoption services. Sponsors educational services to prevent cruelty to animals.

shelters.name: Animal A.I.D. of Mississippi
shelters.description: All volunteer foster-based 501(c)(3) providing care, nurturing and medical treatment for abused, neglected and abandoned dogs and cats.

shelters.name: Mississippi Animal Rescue League (MARL)
shelters.description: Animal rescue league serving the Jackson metro area with adoption and rescue services.

shelters.name: St. Francis Animal Sanctuary
shelters.description: Animal sanctuary serving the Jackson area providing care for animals in need.

shelters.name: Rankin County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: County animal shelter serving Rankin County near Jackson.

shelters.name: Hancock County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Provides temporary shelter with health screening, vaccinations, and mandatory spay/neutering of all adopted animals.

shelters.name: New Hope Animal Rescue of Petal
shelters.description: Working to make a safe haven for homeless and unwanted pets in the Hattiesburg area.

shelters.name: For Pet's Sake Rescue
shelters.description: Committed to rescue, rehabilitate, and rehome animals along the Gulf Coast.

shelters.name: Fixin The Coast
shelters.description: Mississippi 501(c)(3) nonprofit focused on feral cats through TNR (Trap, Neuter/Spay, Return).

shelters.name: Mississippi Coalition for Animal Protection
shelters.description: Coalition working to improve animal welfare across Mississippi.

shelters.name: Jackson County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: County animal shelter serving Jackson County on the Gulf Coast.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Mississippi animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Humane Society of South Mississippi (incorporated 1952) is the only open admissions shelter in South Mississippi. Tupelo-Lee Humane Society (founded 1979) houses 6,000 animals annually. Coverage spans Gulfport, Hattiesburg, Tupelo, Jackson, Biloxi area, and Gulf Coast.
